summary: Reproduced at cf220845799b. With ComboSampler(temperature=0.05), return_probs and return_top_tokens=3, the reported top-token probabilities [0.3055, 0.1215, 0.0661] for tokens [12095, 32671, 510] match softmax of the raw model logits ([0.3050, 0.1232, 0.0654]) rather than the temperature-scaled distribution the sampler draws from ([1.0, 1.3e-8, 4.3e-14]).
what_ran: repro.py runs one 1-token job through the Generator with Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct on physical GPU 1 and recomputes both reference distributions from model.forward on the same prompt.
limits: Temperature only; allowed/blocked-token constraints and DefaultSampler's min-p were not exercised separately.
